commandCenter.title: Finance Command Center
commandCenter.subtitle: Payments, receipts, prepayments, and ledger audit for Denali operators
commandCenter.subtitleFirstCustomer: Payments, receipts, outstanding balances, refunds, and ledger audit for Denali operators
commandCenter.commercialMeaningGuidance: Commercial Meaning shows the financial case interpretation for one registration — not a payment queue. Refresh always runs a new execution. Classic payment and receipt actions stay on Operational View.
commandCenter.commercialMeaningNeedsRegistration: Select a registration filter (from bookings or a finance list) to load Commercial Meaning.
commandCenter.tabGuidance: Manual payment = open debt on a booking. Prepayment = wallet credit before full settlement. Receipts = review member proof (portal upload). Ledger = audit journal only.
commandCenter.tabGuidanceFirstCustomer: Manual payment = open debt on a booking. Receipts = review member proof (portal upload). Ledger = audit journal only.
commandCenter.decisionGuideManual: Manual payment — open a pending debt when the member will pay offline / transfer; then review the receipt.
commandCenter.decisionGuideReceipt: Receipts — review member-submitted proof; approve or reject against the booking balance.
commandCenter.decisionGuidePrepayment: Prepayment — credit the booking wallet before the invoice is fully settled (partial progress toward total).
commandCenter.decisionGuideInstallment: Installments — only when a payment schedule is enabled for the workspace; splits the invoice across due dates.
commandCenter.operatorStateUnpaid: Unpaid booking → usually wait for member proof (Receipts). Create a pending manual payment in Payments only as an exception. Does not settle the booking.
commandCenter.operatorStatePartial: Partial booking → Payments if balance remains; Receipts only when proof is waiting for review.
commandCenter.operatorStatePendingPayment: Pending payment → Payments. Label means Pending (this payment), not receipt review.
commandCenter.operatorStatePendingReceipt: Pending receipt → Receipts. Label means Pending review (receipt).
commandCenter.operatorStatePaid: Paid booking → no collection action. History and Meaning are read-only.
commandCenter.operatorStateVocabRecorded: Recorded (this payment) — this payment row only
commandCenter.tabGuidanceFirstCustomerUx1: Needs action first. Outstanding = money still owed. Payments open collection. Receipts review proof. Refunds return collected money. Ledger is audit only.
commandCenter.commercialMeaningGuidanceSimple: Registration financial summary for this booking — collection actions stay on the other tabs.
commandCenter.operatorStateOutstanding: Outstanding balance → Outstanding tab: who owes and how much (server remaining).

commandBridge.title: Command Bridge — review receipt
commandBridge.guidance: Capability tokens show Case-coherent actions only. Host session still authorizes the POST. Confirmation is required. Meaning refreshes after success — no optimistic state.
commandBridge.noTokens: No reviewReceipt tokens are Case-coherent for this reading.
commandBridge.confirmBody: Submit {token} for receipt {receiptId}? FinanceService remains the mutation authority.

failures.auth_denied: Permission denied ({message}). This is not a Case forbid.
failures.vocabulary_denied: Case vocabulary denied ({message}). Meaning will refresh.
failures.reexecute_failed: Mutation may have landed; Meaning re-execute failed ({message}). Refresh forced.

overview.title: Overview
overview.auditSectionHint: Ledger and reconciliation are for verification — not the daily review queue.
overview.triageStaysInSettings: Reconciliation triage stays under Settings — Finance only links here.
overview.attentionEmpty: Nothing queued for attention right now.
overview.attentionPreviewHint: Preview only — full queues are Payments and Receipts.
overview.needsActionHint: Start with follow-ups, then refunds waiting, then collection queues.
overview.moneyOwedHint: Server remaining balances — not a sum of payment rows. Age buckets are not available yet.
overview.collectedByTourHint: Historical collected payments by tour — not outstanding debt.

exceptions.title: Follow-ups
exceptions.subtitle: Exceptions that need operator navigation — not a new queue or mutation inbox.
exceptions.meaningRejectedReceiptPending: Payment intent is still open; submitted proof was rejected.
exceptions.meaningCancelledWithBalance: Payment intent cancelled but booking still has remaining balance.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.subtitle: Manual offline refunds — Complete is the only action that changes collected money.
refunds.paymentMustBePaid: Only recorded (Paid) manual payments can be refunded — not Pending or Cancelled.
refunds.prepaymentExplicit: This refund returns prepayment wallet credit (no payment row).
refunds.amountServerCapHint: Refundable amount is validated on the server — do not invent a client cap.
refunds.moneyGateHint: Requested, Approved, Rejected, and Cancelled never change invoice remaining. Only Complete does.
refunds.completeConfirmBody: Complete records an offline cash return and updates invoice collected/remaining on the server.
refunds.completeConfirmInvoiceHint: After complete, refresh uses server invoice facts — no browser arithmetic.

errors.REFUND_OVER_CAP: Amount exceeds refundable collected money. Facts refreshed.
errors.REFUND_PAYMENT_NOT_PAID: Only Paid manual payments can be refunded.
errors.REFUND_NOT_TRANSITIONABLE: This refund cannot move to that status.

refunds.requestFromPaymentHint: Prefill from a recorded payment — confirm amount and reason before requesting.
refunds.completeSuccessSettled: Refund completed. Remaining balance is now {remaining}.
refunds.completeSuccessReopened: Refund completed. This registration now has an outstanding balance of {remaining}.

payments.createManualHint: Opens a Pending payment record. It does not settle the booking by itself.
payments.createDoesNotSettle: Creating a payment records open debt only — booking settlement still depends on approved proof and remaining balance.
payments.createResultNext: Next: member may upload proof in the portal; review happens on Receipts.
payments.receiptSubmittedNext: Next: review this proof in Receipts.
payments.submitReceiptAdvanced: Advanced: operator receipt by file key
payments.submitReceiptHint: Members upload proof in the portal. Use Receipts to approve or reject. Prefer “Use this payment” on a Pending row instead of typing a payment ID.
payments.paymentIdPrefillHint: Prefer selecting a Pending payment from the list. Manual UUID entry is ops/debug only.
payments.receiptUploadHint: Select a registration in the create form (or via Use this payment), then upload JPEG/PNG/PDF — file key fills automatically.
payments.listScopeHint: This list shows Manual method rows only (not online gateway payments).
payments.settlementHint: Payment Paid means this payment record is recorded — booking settlement may still show a remaining balance.
payments.obligationHint: Balances describe the booking obligation — not a single payment row.
payments.pendingPaymentMeaning: This payment is open. It does not mean a receipt is waiting for review.
payments.paidPaymentScopeHint: This payment is recorded. Booking settlement may still be partial if remaining balance exists.
payments.stripBookingSettlementPartialRecorded: Booking is partially paid — payments recorded here do not mean the booking is settled while a balance remains.
payments.stripBookingSettlementPartialPending: Booking is partially paid — an open payment is still pending.
payments.stripBookingSettlementPartial: Booking is partially paid — balance remains.
payments.stripBookingSettlementUnpaidPending: Booking is unpaid — an open payment is still pending.
payments.stripBookingSettlementUnpaid: Booking is unpaid — no settlement yet.
payments.stripNextStepPaymentsHint: An open payment is still pending for this booking.
payments.stripNextStepPaymentsNeutralHint: An open payment is still pending. A receipt may also be waiting for review — start in Payments.
payments.stripNextStepPaymentsBalanceHint: A remaining balance is due — open Payments to review payment intents and history. Create a pending manual payment only if finance must open one.
payments.stripNextStepReceiptsHint: A receipt is waiting for review for this booking.
payments.stripSettledReadOnly: Settled — no payment action needed. History below is read-only.
payments.empty: No manual payments yet. Review proof on Receipts; create a pending manual payment only if finance must open an intent.
payments.emptyRegistration: No manual payments for this registration yet. Waiting for member proof is normal — review on Receipts. Create a pending manual payment only as an exception.
payments.cancelDialogBody: This payment has not been recorded. Cancelling closes this payment intent; booking settlement will not change. You can create a new payment later if a balance remains.
payments.cancelSuccess: Manual payment cancelled. You can create a new payment if needed.
payments.cancelErrorPaid: This payment can no longer be cancelled (already recorded). Refresh the list.
payments.cancelErrorPendingReceipt: A receipt is still pending review on this payment. Reject or approve it first.
payments.cancelErrorNotCancellable: This payment is not cancellable in its current state. Refresh the list.
payments.cancelErrorNotFound: Payment is unavailable or out of your scope.
payments.cancelReasonNoteRequired: A note is required for Other.

receipts.reviewRoleHint: Review member proof here. Booking link is only if you need more registration detail.
receipts.primaryPathHint: Daily reviews use this queue. Advanced Command review stays under Commercial Meaning.
receipts.queueMayMore: There may be more items in the queue
receipts.emptyNextHint: Open payments if you need to record open debt or check payment status for a registration.
receipts.invoiceUnavailable: Balance unavailable — backend still enforces overpay rules.
receipts.previewUnavailable: Proof unavailable. You can still decide from the amounts above.
receipts.resultRejected: Rejected. Booking stays unpaid. Member can re-upload on the same pending payment.

picker.label: Booking / registration
picker.searchPlaceholder: Search by tour title or guest name…

installments.semanticsPartial: Partial — this installment row is only partly paid toward its own amount (paidMinor < amountMinor).
installments.semanticsPrepayment: Prepayment — wallet credit on the booking (Prepayments tab); it is not the same as a partial installment.
installments.actionsDeferred: Record payment / waive / reschedule are not available yet — no stub buttons until outbox-backed APIs land.
installments.semanticsMutate: Waive (admin + reason, outbox audit) and reschedule (new due date) are available on open installment rows.
installments.partialHint: This installment is partially paid. Use Prepayments or Manual payment for money movement until installment capture ships.

fields.headline: Headline
fields.noAttention: No attention signal for this case
fields.capabilityReadOnlyNote: Read-only metadata — no approve/reject controls on this surface.

attentionClass.reconciliation_attention: Attention required: payment evidence differs from recorded settlement

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.auditSubtitle: Read-only accounting journal for audit — not the daily payments queue.

validation.REGISTRATION_ID_INVALID: Registration ID must be a valid UUID.
validation.PAYMENT_ID_INVALID: Payment ID must be a valid UUID.
validation.AMOUNT_POSITIVE_INTEGER: Amount must be a positive integer (rials / minor units).
validation.NOTE_MAX_LENGTH: Note must be at most 2000 characters.
validation.INVOICE_TOTAL_POSITIVE: Invoice total must be a positive integer (rials / minor units).
validation.DEPOSIT_PERCENT_RANGE: Deposit percent must be between 0 and 100.
validation.REVIEW_NOTE_MAX: Review note must be at most 2000 characters.
validation.DECISION_INVALID: Decision must be approve or reject.

errors.RECEIPTS_FETCH_FAILED: Failed to load the receipt review queue. Try again.
errors.PAYMENTS_FETCH_FAILED: Failed to load payments. Try again.
errors.EXCEPTIONS_FETCH_FAILED: Failed to load finance follow-ups. Try again.
errors.PREPAYMENTS_FETCH_FAILED: Failed to load prepayments. Try again.
errors.SCHEDULES_FETCH_FAILED: Failed to load installment schedules. Try again.
errors.SCHEDULE_ITEM_PATCH_FAILED: Could not update the installment. Try again.
errors.SET_OBLIGATION_OVERRIDE_FAILED: Updating the expected registration balance failed.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

outstanding.title: Outstanding
outstanding.subtitle: Who still owes money — remaining comes from the registration invoice on the server.
outstanding.hasMoreHint: More rows available — refresh or narrow filters on a later page.
outstanding.agingUnavailable: Age buckets (Current / 1–30 / 31–60 / 61+ days) are not available yet. Dates below are when the obligation opened on the server — not a collection deadline or SLA.
